title: Mom’s Creamed Onions
tagline: Small white onions in a cream sauce with nutmeg and a little Tabasco.

items: 2 lbs. small white onions, or drained canned, boiled onions (Mrs. White’s Onions — glass jars — are the best)
Pinch each of nutmeg and salt

steps.text: To peel fresh onions, cut a slice off one end; place onions in a pot with water to cover. Bring to a boil; remove from heat and cool slightly. Skins should slip off easily.
Place back in water; simmer until tender; drain well.
Meanwhile in a heavy saucepan melt butter. Gradually stir in flour until smooth. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, 5 minutes, and set aside.
In a small saucepan, scald cream. Gradually whisk or stir into butter mixture; add seasonings; stir until thick and smooth.
